agenda_text:
AGENDA
  ALHAMBRA PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING
  Joslyn Adult Center
  210 N. Chapel Avenue, Alhambra CA 91801
  April 4, 2019 7:00 p.m.

Commissioners  Members Ex Officio

Donald Mumford, President  Patricia Rodriguez-Mackintosh, Board of Education
Frank Bodeman, Vice President  Jessica Binnquist, City Manager
Glenn Barnett  Michael Macias, Director of Parks & Recreation
Bella Flowers
Gary Guevara
Laura Longoria
Maurice Norrington
Anthony Seto
Cecilia Talavera

We welcome you to the Parks and Recreation Commission meeting.

If you wish to address the Commission during the meeting, please complete a speaker’s card and give
it to the secretary. The maximum time for addressing the Commission is five minutes. If you wish
to address the Commission on an item which appears on the agenda, your comments will be heard
during the Commission’s discussion of that item. If you wish to address the Commission on a subject
which does not appear on the agenda but related to recreation or community service, you may make
your presentation under Agenda item VIII. Please be advised that the Commission cannot, under the
provisions of the State of California’s Ralph M. Brown Act, take action on any item which does not
appear on the agenda.

When making your presentation, please give your name and address for the record, and make your
statement as brief as possible.

Thank you.

I.  Roll Call

II.  Flag Salute

III. Introduction of new Commissioners

IV. Approval of the Minutes of the regular meeting of March 7, 2019
  (Only those Commissioners present at the 3/7/19 meeting may vote on these minutes. Commissioners who were
  not present must abstain).

V.  Election of Officers for the 2019/2020 term of office
  President
  Vice-President
 VI. Tree City USA

VII. News & Events

VIII. Oral Communications

IX. Commission Orals

X.  Adjournment

Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business described
hereinabove are on file in the Department of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First
Street, Alhambra, California are available for public inspection during regular office hours which are
Monday through Friday 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

Should any person have a question concerning any of the above agenda items prior to the meeting
described herein, he or she may contact Mr. Michael Macias, Director of Parks & Recreation, either in
person at the Parks & Recreation Department or by telephone at (626) 570-5044.
